title: LockApp
tagline: B2B SaaS for remote Android device management on EMI plans
description: LockApp is an enterprise-grade mobile device management and EMI enforcement system for electronics retailers and NBFCs financing smartphones. The platform combines a custom Android device management agent with a multi-tenant cloud control plane.

title: NavratriOS
tagline: Multi-tenant festival registration and gate-entry QR SaaS
description: NavratriOS is a specialized ticketing and entry management platform built to handle tens of thousands of concurrent festival attendees with sub-second QR code scanning at physical venue gates, instant fraud detection, and real-time pass generation.
metrics: Sub-second gate validation via handheld scanners
Zero-downtime registration spikes under heavy load
Real-time attendance analytics and pass management

title: Wirebench
tagline: Private API client with contract-drift detection and team changelog
description: Wirebench is a lightweight, privacy-first API testing and documentation workbench for distributed engineering teams. It continuously monitors live endpoint contracts against OpenAPI schemas and flags breaking changes before staging deployment.
metrics: Zero cloud data leaks — runs locally and in private VPC
